findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: fact_validate, doc_verify_facts, doc_abstract_lease, doc_spread_statement, doc_check_use_conflict, lease_comp_validate, search, fetch · Private data: calc_direct_cap, rules_tx_property_tax_protest_deadline, id_entity, id_document, fact_validate, doc_verify_facts, doc_abstract_lease, doc_compare, doc_verify_claim, doc_spread_statement, fact_package_create, fact_package_verify, search, fetch · Public sink: calc_cam_reconciliation, calc_cam_reconciliation_batch, calc_capex_recovery, calc_lease_remeasurement_asc842, calc_prepayment_and_defeasance, calc_dcf_pro_forma, calc_direct_cap, doc_verify_facts, doc_spread_statement, lease_comp_validate · Destructive: calc_rent_schedule, calc_amortization_schedule, id_parcel.
